rules.earth_instinct: Probably dust or a bad sensor. Wait and see.
rules.vesta_decides: Treat the alarm as an early-phase fire. Warn, gather, send the alert.
rules.limits: A design statement from the SAME fact sheet about what detection must target; it did not test this vehicle's detector.
rules.nasa_showed: Given the constrained space on any spacecraft, the target for the fire detection system is necessarily the early phase and not established flaming fires; consequently, the primary target for detection is pyrolysis products rather than soot.

rules.vesta_decides: Stop forced airflow to the module.
rules.limits: Review statements about microgravity experiments in general; no oxygen level is stated and this cabin is at 34 %.
rules.nasa_showed: Microgravity experiments demonstrated that the assumed margin of safety of reduced flammability in microgravity, based on quiescent test results, may not be valid for most spacecraft environments where ventilation flow strongly enhances flames.

rules.vesta_decides: Search all around the source, not above it; sample behind the panel.
rules.limits: Describes low-momentum flames on the station; a jet or a pressurised leak behaves differently.
rules.nasa_showed: In microgravity, this flow doesn't occur and on the space station, low-momentum flames tend to be rounded or even spherical.

rules.vesta_decides: Remove power from the zone before discharging anything.
rules.nasa_showed: crew will proceed to unpower the equipment behind the panel, thus attacking the Ignition Source (Heat) leg of the fire triangle.

rules.earth_instinct: Aim at the base of the flame.
rules.vesta_decides: Do not rely on a close jet aimed at the flame. Discharge into the enclosed volume and confirm with the sensors.
rules.limits: BASS burned small solid samples in a flow duct. The quotes show that a local jet can fail; they do not show that flooding works. No oxygen level is stated.
rules.nasa_showed: Also, current findings show that local application of suppressant is not adequate for flame extinguishment. The local jet entrains air and sustains the flame even when the ambient airflow is turned off.

rules.vesta_decides: Masks stay on. Keep sampling combustion products until the readings are clear.
rules.limits: Cool flames were seen on liquid fuel droplets (FLEX). This fire is solid or electrical: a different fuel class.
rules.nasa_showed: FLEX, which analyzed the effectiveness of fire suppressants, led to the discovery of a type of cool flame, where the fuel continued "burning" under certain conditions after extinction of the visible flame.

rules.earth_instinct: If it passed the flammability test on Earth, it is fine in space.
rules.vesta_decides: Treat Earth test margins as unproven for this cabin: check the material on the Design map.
rules.limits: The sentences state no oxygen level; the cabin's oxygen may lie outside every solid test in the base.
rules.nasa_showed: Recent results from the BASS experiment currently running on the ISS indicate that NASA-STD-6001 Test 1 is not conservative, and materials can burn at lower oxygen levels in microgravity than on Earth.
